name.description:
The user's full name.
The default is derived from {@link User.firstName} if preferredName has not been set.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

session.description:
The member's default session accessible from the UI. Setting this to null indicates that the user doesn't have a
default session, in which case calls to {@link sessionStatus} will always return "stopped"

preferredName.description: The name that a user would like to have

email.description: The user's email, allowing it to be seen by team members despite ACL restrictions.

recognition.description: The user's name and email combined.

pendoVisitorId.description:
The `visitorId` for usage tracking in {@link Pendo}. This will be set either upon initial signup (for new users)
or on first login after the Pendo feature is added to the environment. Since the visitorId is determined
client-side, there is no way to populate this via a migration. Whether this field is populated will determine
whether initial logic to set the "Do Not Process" flag will be run in order to comply with GDPR.

size.description:
Selected memory size of the service.
The memory size to use when invoking {@link ExMachinaSession#startDefaultForMember}

autoShutdownPeriod.description: Selected time after which the service will be shutdown automatically if idle.

maxSize.description: Maxmimum memory size of the member.

current.description: Whether the user is logged in as the current member. Used to enforce account-level ACLs

sizeApprovals.description:
The ordered list of approved size requests. The latest is the current approval. If there are none,
the account's defaultMaxSize is the size.

title:
Note permissions to functions that update members need to be strictly controlled; otherwise, any User may modify
any ExMachinaUser to which they have access.
name: ExMachinaUser
